faq_heading: New construction in Langley City: your questions answered

faq.q: What have condos in Langley City sold for?
faq.a: 214 condos sold in Langley City at a median of $463,000, with the middle half between $408,500 and $508,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Langley City?
faq.a: Houses in Langley City took 27 days at a median to sell.

faq.q: Which homes in Langley City are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in Langley City, condos had the newest median build year, 2006.

blocks.text: What you see above is a live MLS® search for Langley City: active houses, townhomes and condos with an age of 0 or less, so this year's completions and homes still being built. Over November 2025 to October 2026, the busiest home type in Langley City was condos: 214 sales at a median of $463,000, and 3 types had 5 or more sales.

items.t: 91 houses sold in Langley City at a median of $1,200,000 (middle half $1,072,000 to $1,380,000). A typical house in Langley City spent 27 days on the market and closed at 96.0% of the asking price.
In Langley City, townhomes sold at a median of $740,000 across 67 sales, and the middle half closed between $629,950 and $777,000. The median townhome sat 27 days and sold for 97.5% of list.
Langley City: 214 condos sold at a median of $463,000, with the middle half between $408,500 and $508,000. The median condo took 27 days to sell and closed at 96.7% of list.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Langley City compares with the rest of Langley

items.t: Of 9 Langley sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Langley City ranks second lowest at $1,200,000; the range is $1,025,000 (Aldergrove) to $2,565,000 (Campbell Valley). Aldergrove ($1,025,000) sits just below and Walnut Grove ($1,344,250) sits just above.

Townhomes in Langley City have the second lowest median of 6 Langley sub-areas, $740,000. Aldergrove is lowest at $560,000 and Fort Langley highest at $1,395,000. Aldergrove ($560,000) sits just below and Murrayville ($807,500) sits just above.

Of 7 Langley sub-areas with 5 or more condo sales, Langley City ranks second lowest at $463,000; the range is $432,500 (Aldergrove) to $800,000 (Fort Langley). Aldergrove ($432,500) sits just below and Salmon River ($480,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, condos are the newest homes selling in Langley City (median 2006) and houses the oldest (median 1978), a gap of 28 years.
